## About
All Auto Body Inc. is an auto body shop on Touhy Ave in Elk Grove Village. We handle everything from collision repair to custom auto body work, and we work with most insurance companies.
The goal has always been simple: be the kind of shop that delivers what it promises. We want you to tell your family and friends you had a good experience here, and to come back knowing you picked the right shop for the job.
Paint work is done with the Sherwin Williams Automotive Refinishing System. Ron, the owner, and his team handle the work.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repairs after an accident, from minor damage to major work.
- Bumper and fender repair: Fixing dented, cracked or damaged bumpers and fenders.
- Paint work: Painting with the latest automotive paints for your vehicle.
- Paintless dent removal: Taking out dents without repainting the panel.
